content: Paraphrases are textual expressions that have the same semantic meaning using different surface words. Paraphrase identification (PI) is the task of identifying whether two sentences have the same meaning or not. We use BERT BIBREF11 and XLNet BIBREF43 as backbones and report F1 score for comparison. Hyperparameters are tuned on the development set of each dataset.
